text: I started keeping a list. Dates, what he said, what happened.
How long is it?
Long enough that I stopped being angry and started being curious.
I am done with the shortcuts. From here it is by the book, every dive, every invoice.
You have said that in some form every year I have known you.
This time I have written it down.
He paid the whole arrears. In cash. On a Tuesday, unasked.
So he does do it sometimes.
Sometimes is the problem. If it were never, we would all have left.
There is a dive Thursday. If you tell me a depth I want that to be the depth.
Forty metres. I will not go below forty.
His gauge logged fifty-eight.
Put it on the list.
You are showing that list to people.
I am showing it to you.
Read it to me then.
The compressor. The solo dive on the shelf. My dive log. My seat on the contract. My full share. The charter fee. Okonkwo's one contract. Forty metres.
Some of those had reasons.
All of them had reasons. Not one of them had a different ending.
He is not trying to hurt you. He is trying to show you a shape.
If I asked you for one more month, what would you say.
I would say yes, and I would hate myself, and we would be here again in a month.
I am not going to promise you anything anymore.
That might be the first useful thing you have said in six years.
He turned down the Cabo job. Said he could not staff it honestly.
Nothing on my list is about a job he turned down.
Do you want him to change, or do you want to be right?
I want to stop having to guess.
Thursday. Forty metres. Come down with the gauge and watch it yourself.
That is not a promise. That is an audit.
I know. Take the audit.
